title: Rav Tachlifa, Father of Rav Huna bar Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yoma 6b and Keritot 25b, reporting Rava. Hyman explains that they called him after his son because his son’s name was better known.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Yoma 6b fully writes Rav Tachlifa, father of Rav Huna, supporting Huna for the heading’s abbreviation. The reason for calling him after his son is Hyman’s explanation.

The saved whole William Davidson Yoma 6b paragraph names Rav Tachlifa, father of Rav Huna (bar Tachlifa), reporting Rava. Hyman’s explanation that his son was better known remains attributed. Keritot 25b has not been freshly collated here.
